provenance: diagnosis accuracy needs a ground truth the classifier cannot argue with. The rows are the (action, error) pairs the executor can actually raise; the expected class is the taxonomy cell each belongs to (docs/evals/failure-taxonomy.md). Two rows carry the load: a ResolveError is `locate` whatever the action was, and the SAME TimeoutError is `nav` on a navigate and `act` on a click — the action, not the exception, decides. Classification is rules over errors and page state, never an LLM.
